Can I self-host Tiptap or run it on-premises?
Yes. You get three options: Tiptap Cloud, Dedicated Cloud, or On-Premises via Docker in your own infrastructure. Regulated teams usually pick On-Premises so content never leaves their network.
Can I use my own AI model, or does my content go to OpenAI?
It’s your choice. The AI Toolkit is model-agnostic. Run it with your own LLM infrastructure, on-prem or client-side.

You can to some extent. But then you own every extension, security patch, bug fix, and edge case forever. Tiptap Cloud defaults to EU hosting, with a US option. Or self-host anywhere with On-Premises.

: the SOC 2 Type II report under NDA, a DPA, the subprocessor list, and the On-Premises option. Send us the questionnaire and we'll turn it around.
